$comment: Numbers Kisan Saathi's Help tab shows (K23). A wrong official number is worse than none, so every entry names a source in `sources` with the date it was checked, and a number with no official source is left out: Patiala's Chief Agriculture Officer is missing because only unofficial directories list it. `everywhere` shows in every district; `districts` adds a district's own offices. Check these again before the demo. src/__tests__/kisan-help.test.ts holds the file to these rules.
